== Events ==
* [[Alice declares the court nothing but a pack of cards and defies the Queen's orders, causing the card-creatures to fly at her and disperse]]
* [[Alice observes the courtroom proceedings and notes the absurdity of the twelve jurors writing down their names before the trial has begun]]
* [[The creatures demand Alice repeat lessons; she attempts 'Tis the voice of the Sluggard' but it becomes 'Tis the voice of the Lobster' due to her distraction with the dance]]
* [[Alice re-enters the hall, uses the golden key to reach the garden, and eats the mushroom to shrink, finally arriving in the beautiful garden with flower-beds and fountains]]
* [[She discovers an unlabeled bottle in the Rabbit's room and drinks from it, causing her to grow rapidly until she becomes trapped in the room with her limbs protruding from the window and chimney]]
* [[Alice grows to nine feet tall and her body becomes disproportionately large, causing her distress about managing her distant feet]]
* [[The Queen asks if Alice has seen the Mock Turtle and offers to have him tell his history; Alice meets the Gryphon, who assures her the Queen never actually executes anyone]]
* [[Alice, bored while sitting by her sister, becomes curious when she spots a White Rabbit wearing a waistcoat and carrying a watch]]
* [[The Rabbit and other animals outside attempt to retrieve Alice, including sending a creature named Bill down the chimney, whom Alice kicks out violently]]
* [[The Dormouse tells a rambling story about three sisters named Elsie, Lacie, and Tillie who lived at the bottom of a treacle-well and learned to draw things beginning with M]]
